extracted.name: Barramundi with Lemon Basil Sauce
extracted.description: This baked barramundi, or Asian sea bass, features a seasoned bread crumb crust and is topped with a lemon-butter-basil sauce for a flavorful dish.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed
0.5 teaspoon seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil, or to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Brush fish fillets with olive oil.
Make topping: Mix together bread crumbs, seafood seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, lemon zest, and thyme on a large plate until well combined.
Press fillets into bread crumb mixture to coat all sides. Arrange coated fillets on a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Flip fillets and continue baking until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 10 minutes more.
Make sauce: Stir together melted butter, lemon juice, white wine, and basil in a small bowl until well combined.
Drizzle sauce over fish to serve.
